first.title: Every call to an outside service sets a timeout of ten seconds or less
first.when: adding or changing a call to an outside service
first.why: an unbounded wait in one call stalls the whole job queue
first.context: Jobs run one at a time from a single queue.
first.false-if: a service this project depends on needs more than ten seconds

second.title: A change to the guide is read aloud once before it is sent
second.when: changing a page of the user guide
second.why: a page nobody read back went out with a wrong command twice
second.context: The guide is the only thing most users read.
second.false-if: the guide is generated from the code

a.task: raise the timeout of the export call
